_comment: What an unidentified (broken) Tower Artifact looks like. Several artifacts share each appearance, so you can't tell them apart by looks. PLACEHOLDER wording.

glass.name: broken glass curio
glass.description: A piece of strange old glass, cracked or clouded. It's a Tower Artifact, but you can't tell what it was.

brass.name: broken brass device
brass.description: Old metalwork, bent and seized. It's a Tower Artifact, but you can't tell what it was.

bell.name: broken ringing thing
bell.description: Metal that should ring and doesn't. It's a Tower Artifact, but you can't tell what it was.

stone.name: broken stone token
stone.description: Carved stone, worn and split. It's a Tower Artifact, but you can't tell what it was.
